fact: The national digital health strategy 2021-2025 reports that an African Development Bank study of six hospitals found only the Sino-Guinean hospital has a partial functioning digitisation system, and that the country must update its legal framework to allow a national electronic medical record.
title: Stratégie Nationale Santé Numérique 2021-2025
publisher: Ministère de la Santé Publique, République de Guinée
